1903 is not a leap year (1900 is not a leap year under Gregorian rules).  
03-23-1903 minus 163 days:  
March has 31 days, so 23 days in March → back to March 1 is 22 days.  
163 − 22 = 141 days left to go back into previous months.  
February 1903 has 28 days → 141 − 28 = 113 left after February.  
January has 31 days → 113 − 31 = 82 left after January.  
December 1902 has 31 days → 82 − 31 = 51 left after December.  
November 1902 has 30 days → 51 − 30 = 21 left after November.  
October 1902 has 31 days → 21 − 31 = −10, so we go into October: October 31 − 10 = October 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1902-10-21
